styleGoal: A warm honey-wood barrel with softly lit cartoon volume, readable wooden lid/staves, and navy metal hoops.

shapeVolume: Keep the existing compact bulging barrel, closed planked lid, vertical stave structure and two navy hoops recognizably intact.

Use gentle edge transitions and coherent volume so lid, upper shoulder, body and hoops separate clearly at logical display size; retain useful faceting rather than requiring a smooth or photoreal surface.
color: Preserve the honey/golden wood and dark navy hoop palette family, with restrained warm variation between lid, shoulder and body.
Avoid the source's nearly flat lemon-yellow lid and muddy, strongly darkened lower body; retain readable warmth in the lower staves without flattening form.
lightingHighlights: Show broad, soft transitions over the wood and modest edge highlights on the hoops; the lid must retain wood color and plank detail without clipping or glare.
Hoops should read as solid navy bands with controlled volume, without requiring the target's stronger glossy accents.
Use no preferred horizontal light direction and no directional ground cast shadow across the four actual native rotations.
materialDetail: Plank and stave divisions remain deliberate and legible, with softly defined seam depth and tidy edge contacts.
Wood may carry subtle tonal variation, but fine grain, extra noise, decorative hardware and high gloss are not required.
Preserve the actual native lid and stave identity rather than copying altered AI topology or adding unestablished unseen details.
artifactFreeReadability: At 192 x 352 logical display size, the closed lid, barrel body, wood segmentation and two navy hoops read immediately in N, E, S and W.
No black gaps, muddy merged regions, coplanar flicker, exposed seams, broken corners, abrupt normal bands, clipping, stray pixels or halo fringes on light, gray and dark backgrounds.
The repeated preview has coherent scale and material treatment, clear individual silhouettes and no repetitive defect that overwhelms the simple prop.

hardConstraints: Native editable Blender output with actual model rotation for N, E, S and W; no raster-facing card, image fitting or per-view recoloring.
Preserve capture frame 384 x 704, logical frame 192 x 352, logical root [96, 248], sourceScale 2 and registered top-down-oblique-square-grid camera.
Preserve the one-cell footprint, source height/proportions, root, socket/port state and original model identity.
Preserve one static frame for every required facing, static/non-loop semantics, and the catalog's 12 fps metadata.
Inspect all four native views, four-view-sheet and repeated previews, with passing hash-bound capture/asset validation before approval.
targetInterpretation: The target establishes warm softened material, seam and edge treatment only for its visible facing.
Target canvas/padding or internal placement drift does not override registered native capture and dimensions.

The target's sharper glossy hoop accents, microscopic wood variation, edge halos and any silhouette drift are not mandatory; unseen views require coherent native continuation, not invented reference facings.
priorityOrder: Warm, softly modeled wood with a readable colored lid and lower staves.
Tidy plank/stave seams and softly defined hoop/shoulder edges that retain the original barrel structure.
Consistent native rotations and clean repeated-size presentation within the registered contract.
approvalRule: Visible material improvement toward these criteria, no material visual defects in required views/previews, and passing technical evidence. Scores are comparative observations and are not an automatic approval threshold.
